title: Domains and common fraction field for monoid algebras
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $G$ be a torsion-free abelian group, and let $Q\subseteq G$ be a finitely generated submonoid that generates $G$ as a group. The monomial map embeds $k[Q]$ into the group algebra $k[G]$; both are integral domains, and the fraction field of $k[Q]$ identifies with the fraction field of $k[G]$ (equivalently, every monomial of $k[G]$ is a quotient of two monomials from $k[Q]$). We use the monoid and group-completion conventions of [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup].
